units.source_text: 将近夜半，源氏公子蒙眬入睡，恍惚看见枕畔坐着一个绝色美女，

en.t: Near midnight, Prince Genji drifted into a hazy sleep and dimly saw an extraordinarily beautiful woman sitting by his pillow,

units.source_text: 对他说道：“我为你少年英俊，故而倾心爱慕。

en.t: and she said to him, "Because you are young and handsome, I gave my heart to you.

units.source_text: 岂知你对我全不顾念，却陪着这个毫不足道的女人到这里来，百般宠爱。

en.t: Yet I never imagined that you would give me no thought at all, and instead come here with this worthless woman and lavish every affection on her.

units.source_text: 如此无情，真真气死我也！”说着，便动手要把睡在他身旁的夕颜拉起来。

en.t: Such heartlessness truly makes me furious!" As she said this, she reached out to pull up Yugao, who was sleeping beside him.

units.source_text: 源氏公子心知着了梦魔，睁开眼睛一看，灯火已熄。

en.t: Prince Genji knew in his heart that he had been seized by a nightmare spirit; when he opened his eyes and looked, the lamp had already gone out.

units.source_text: 他觉得阴气逼人，便拔出佩刀来放在身旁，把右近叫醒。

en.t: Feeling an oppressive chill, he drew his sword, placed it beside him, and woke Ukon.

units.source_text: 右近也很害怕，偎依到源氏公子身边来。

en.t: Ukon was also terribly frightened and came close to Prince Genji's side.

units.source_text: 公子说：“你出去把过廊里的值宿人唤醒，叫他们点纸烛来。”

en.t: The prince said, "Go out and wake the men on night duty in the passageway, and tell them to bring a lit paper taper."

units.source_text: 右近说：“这么黑暗，教我怎么出去呢？”公子笑道：“哈哈，你真像个小孩子。”

en.t: Ukon said, "How can I go out in such darkness?" The prince laughed and said, "Ha, you really are like a child."

units.source_text: 便拍起手来[\[23\]](#part1333.html#m23)。这时候四壁发出回声，光景异常凄惨。

en.t: Then he clapped his hands[\[23\]](#part1333.html#m23). At that moment echoes sounded from all four walls, and the scene became extraordinarily desolate and eerie.

units.source_text: 值宿人却没有听见，一个人也不来。

en.t: But the night attendants did not hear him, and not a single person came.

units.source_text: 夕颜浑身痉挛，默默无言，痛苦万状。

en.t: Yugao's whole body convulsed; silent and wordless, she was in terrible agony.

units.source_text: 出了一身冷汗之后，只剩得奄奄一息了。

en.t: After breaking out in a cold sweat all over, she was left barely breathing.

units.source_text: 右近说：“小姐生来胆怯，平日略有小事，便惊心动魄，现在不知她心里多么难过呢！”

en.t: Ukon said, "My lady has been timid from birth, and even the smallest ordinary thing can terrify her. I cannot imagine how distressed she must be now!"

units.source_text: 源氏公子想：“的确很胆怯，白天也是望着天空发呆，真可怜啊！”

en.t: Prince Genji thought, "She is indeed very timid. Even in the daytime she was staring blankly at the sky. How pitiful!"

units.source_text: 便对右近说：“那么我自己去叫人吧。拍手有回声，很讨厌。

en.t: Then he said to Ukon, "In that case, I will go call someone myself. Clapping only makes echoes, and it is very unpleasant.

units.source_text: 你暂且坐在她身边吧。”右近便走近夕颜身边。

en.t: Sit beside her for the moment." Ukon then moved closer to Yugao's side.

units.source_text: 源氏公子从西面的边门走出去，打开过廊的门一看，灯火也已熄灭了。

en.t: Prince Genji went out through the side door on the west, opened the door to the passageway, and saw that its light had also gone out.

units.source_text: 外边略有夜风。值宿的人很少，都睡着了。

en.t: Outside there was a slight night breeze. There were few attendants on duty, and all of them were asleep.

units.source_text: 共只三人，其中一个是这里的守院人的儿子，即源氏公子经常使唤的一个年轻人，一个是值殿男童，另一个便是那个随从。

en.t: There were only three in all: one was the son of the caretaker here, a young man whom Prince Genji often used as a messenger; one was a palace page; and the other was that attendant.

units.source_text: 那年轻人答应一声，便起身了。

en.t: The young man answered and immediately got up.

units.source_text: 公子对他说：“拿纸烛来。你对随从说，叫他赶快鸣弦，要不断地发出弦声[\[24\]](#part1333.html#m24)。

en.t: The prince said to him, "Bring a paper taper. Tell the attendant to hurry and perform the bowstring rite, and to keep the string sounding without pause[\[24\]](#part1333.html#m24).

units.source_text: 你们在这人迹稀少的地方怎么可以放心睡觉？听说惟光来过，现在哪里？”

en.t: How can you sleep so soundly in such a deserted place? I heard Koremitsu came by. Where is he now?"

units.source_text: 年轻人回答：“他来过了。因为公子没有吩咐他什么，他就回去了，说明天早上再来迎接公子。”

en.t: The young man replied, "He did come. Since Your Highness gave him no instructions, he went back, saying he would come again tomorrow morning to escort you."

units.source_text: 这年轻人是宫中禁卫武士，善于鸣弦，便一面拉弓，一面叫喊“火烛小心”，向守院人的屋子那边走去。

en.t: This young man was an imperial guard from the palace and was skilled at sounding the bowstring; so, drawing the bow as he went, he cried, "Take care with fire," and walked toward the caretaker's quarters.
